title: Venue capabilities, per instrument kind
description: What a venue offers for one kind of instrument (perpetual or spot), as the venue port declares it (src/venues/port.ts, Caps; Hyperliquid's values in src/venues/hyperliquid/port.ts, HL_CAPS; design 0013 decision 10). The send path refuses before signing what the venue does not offer. Price and size precision are the instrument's, not the venue's (hl-instrument).

margin.description: Added 2026-11-14 (design 0064 d7): the exchange's own margin rules for a perpetual kind, from which the app works out what a bot needs from the account. Absent on spot and where the venue offers no perpetuals; absent reads as: market orders margined at the last price, no fee held at placement, no maintenance on resting orders, no check at a fill, the fallback maintenance at 1/max leverage. Each value's source is in the venue's handbook under Margin rules (0064).

orderPrice.description: The price an order's initial margin is taken at: a limit its own; a market order the last price, or above it by premium (Binance 0.0015).

placementFees.description: Fees the exchange holds at placement (Bybit: the fee to open at the taker rate and the fee to close at the non-VIP taker rate, at the bankruptcy price).

fillCheck.description: A resting order's fill is checked again against initial margin (Hyperliquid, assumed).

fallbackMaintenance.description: The maintenance rate assumed where no tier is read: the initial-margin rate at the max leverage (initial, 1/max: Bybit, Binance) or half of it (half-initial: Hyperliquid's documented rule); with no max known, the bot's leverage stands in for it.

uncoveredCancelsIn.description: Added 2026-11-11. Account modes in which an uncovered order cancels other orders holding the coin, for this market kind. An empty or absent list means refusal in every mode. Required in the TypeScript port; an unread account mode counts as unknown.

feeRates.description: Published base maker/taker fractions for display before an account rate read (0040 amendment d28.4).

reduceOnly.description: The venue enforces reduce-only on this kind (Hyperliquid spot: no).

nativeStops.description: The venue's own trigger orders and the price they fire on; null where the venue has none for this kind or they are not used.

placesTriggers.description: Added 2026-11-14 (venue-playbook §8d). The venue's wire places its own trigger orders on this kind, so a stop placed outside the app can be changed as one; absent: it places none (an outside stop is Cancel only).

modify.description: A resting order is changed by cancelling it and placing a new one with a new client order id; the venue's own modify is not used.

batchOrders.description: Several orders in one signed action.

expiresAfterMs.description: Every order and cancel expires this many milliseconds after it is stamped.

buyFeeInBase.description: Added 2026-10-03 (ruling 151): a buy's fee is taken in the coin bought (Hyperliquid spot), so a DCA bot's buys are topped up from its first; fallbackRate is the venue's highest standard taker rate, a fraction (Hyperliquid spot: 0.0007), assumed when the account's own rate cannot be read. Null where the fee is taken in the quote; absent reads as null.

limitBandPct.description: Added 2026-10-03 (B13, release plan B10a): the venue's limit-distance rule, in percent: a limit order priced further than this from the venue's reference price is refused when placed (Hyperliquid perpetuals: 80, the figure of the venue's own refusal text; spot: none known). Absent: no bound, the default for a venue or kind without a known figure. gcx refuses a manual limit beyond it before signing, and a DCA bot holds a level beyond it until the price brings it inside.

stamp.description: Added 2026-10-22 (0037 §10 d1): how a write is stamped: a nonce with its expiry (Hyperliquid), or a timestamp in a receive window (Binance). A journal's send keeps either in its nonce and expiresAfter fields. Absent reads as nonce.

sameIdGuard.description: Added 2026-10-22 (0037 §10 d1): what stops a second send of one order from executing twice: the nonce, under which at most one executes, so the same order may go again under it (0013 Amendment 1 d7 (a), Hyperliquid); none where the venue's own id guard ends with the first order. Absent reads as nonce.

builderFee.description: Added 2026-10-22 (0037 §10 d1): gcx's fee rides each order as the venue's builder fee (Hyperliquid: true); false where the venue has none. Absent reads as true.

marketOrder.description: Added 2026-10-22 (0037 §10 d1, ruling 141 (a)): bounded, a limit priced through the touch within ruling 141's bound, with the order form's Est and Max line (Hyperliquid); native, the venue's own market order. Absent reads as bounded.
